# RMG Advertising: 2027 Readiness Checklist (public site)

The live page at **https://readiness.rmgadvertising.com/**: a five-minute, self-scoring checklist across brand awareness, human touch, advertising, revenue, loyalty and trust, with a readiness score, a Human Touch Index and three suggested moves for Q1 2027.

**This repository holds build output only.** It is generated from the private source repository `RMG-Advertising/rmga-2027-readiness`. Do not edit files here: make changes in the source repo, run `build/build-site.sh`, then copy the result here and push.

- Hosting: GitHub Pages from the repository root, custom domain set in `CNAME`; `.nojekyll` serves files as-is.
- No build step, no tracking, no backend: answers stay in the visitor's browser (localStorage).
